text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
“—Therefore, I am sorry.
Just competing is not enough to satisfy me.”

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
At the Arima Kinen, I...
want to defeat Kris S-san.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Win, and then—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"I have to fight once more."
"No, I *want* to fight." That's what I want them to feel.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"I want to become... someone who makes
people feel that way...!!"

One day before training,
Zenno Rob Roy told me that with
a face full of determination.

Of course, ever since then,
I've trained with her in the hopes of seeing
her strong desire fulfilled.
That said—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I'm ready.
Both mind and body are fully prepared.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I will win. ...Without fail.

Her declaration was brief and quiet, yet
it made the surrounding atmosphere feel distinctly heavier.

My throat moved in an involuntary, heavy swallow.
The pitch-black pressure felt almost visible to the naked eye.
choice_data_list: (To think she's gained such a commanding presence...!)

text_block_list.name: Race Official
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy.
...It's time.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Right away!

With clattering horseshoes and a swaying tail,
she steps forward.
Those words spilled naturally from my lips.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ! —Rob Roy.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hey, Kris S, you know...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I'm delighted by the change in you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――What？

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —...What sort of "change"?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hmm. That's true—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Take, for example, a moment ago, when you were walking with a certain degree of carelessness that is quite uncharacteristic of you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You, who are always acutely aware of your surroundings,
somehow let your guard down and ran into me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Or perhaps, for example, just a moment ago,
taking a seat before I even prompted you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You, who value orders and follow them dutifully,
acted on your own without waiting for my word.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Sorry. That was rude of me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Oh, no, I didn't mean to blame you!
If it sounded like an accusation, I apologize.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"No, that's not it. Just as I told you,
I'm genuinely happy."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Inside of you... yes, I can sense
a certain kind of "wavering" beginning to form.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —'Fluctuation'?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――... "Fluctuation."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: "Fluctuation"...—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Something just crossed your mind, didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—Kris S.
I am deeply grateful to you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Your running style, honed abroad, sent shockwaves through the Japanese racing world and spurred its further growth.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I invited you hoping you would be just that,
and not only did you answer and travel to a distant land,
but you performed far beyond expectations.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Praise is unnecessary.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—I owe a debt of gratitude to the Symboli family.
For discovering me back then.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —I merely... repaid that kindness.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Even so.
Few are able to stay true to a single conviction,
and your way of life is truly noble.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
However, that is precisely why...
I truly am so happy.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I only ask that you please cherish
that flicker of doubt that has sprouted within you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"You're allowed to enjoy your own life, you know,
Symboli Kris S."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Today is... the final race.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: The final, ...—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now, the day has finally arrived—
the grand culmination of this year, the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
All eyes are on Symboli Kris S!
Though retirement has been announced,
her power is as formidable as everâ!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Will today simply be another chapter in her quiet string of victories?!
The Arima Kinen is about to get underway!
Nakayama at year's end is brimming with excitement,nticipating a legendary showdown.

The battle to decide the Grand Prix champion
begins right now.
